Subject: December: the visa change, the solstice and the pound
Preview: Three things for anyone travelling in the next two months.


Hello,

Three things for anyone travelling in the next two months.

1. The visa. From 1 January 2027 the single-entry visa is due to rise from US$30 to US$33, and from US$36 to US$39 at Cairo airport's digital kiosks (ATTA, on a Cabinet decision of 13 August 2026). Visa on arrival is cash only.

2. The solstice. On 21 December the sunrise lines up with Karnak (Africanews with AP, 22 Dec 2025), and the same morning is marked at Qasr Qarun in Fayoum (Explore Fayoum). Karnak opens at 06:00. A December night in Luxor averages about 8 °C and the afternoon 24 (NASA POWER, 2001–2020 normals), so dress for a cold dawn.

3. The pound. Between the first week from 24 July and the week to 19 November 2026, the dollar went from EGP 51.30 to 53.60 (+4.5%). Over the same weeks the median of 128 food prices on the Cabinet's IDSC portal moved +1.9%.

Put your dates in the planner and it lists the holidays and the heat at each stop:

Hello,

Two holidays this month. Eid al-Fitr is expected from 9 or 10 to 12 March, at the end of Ramadan (expected to finish 8 or 9 March). Western Easter is Sunday 28 March. If your trip touches either, book trains and timed tickets early.

Then the heat. A normal afternoon at Karnak is 30 °C in March, 34 in April and 38 in May; at Philae in Aswan, 32, 36 and 40 (NASA POWER, 2001–2020 normals). Giza is gentler: 26, 30 and 34. If you are going to Upper Egypt after mid-April, be at the gate at opening: Karnak and Abu Simbel open at 06:00, Giza at 07:00 (Ministry booking site).
